title: Client Services Bulletin: What a Retrofit Project Changes in the Owner's Other Holdings
content:
# Client Services Bulletin — What a Retrofit Project Changes in the Owner's Other Holdings

A project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects changes what the rest of the owner's portfolio covers, and the two are settled together at closeout.

## Maintenance schedule

Equipment the project replaces leaves the schedule of the building's Preventive Maintenance Agreements on the day it is removed, and the new equipment joins that schedule on the day of substantial completion, with the agreement repriced on its own proration basis. The owner is not charged maintenance on both the old and the new unit for the same period. The closing of a project reads the maintenance agreement at the same building from that agreement's own record, and the agreement is one standing in active, pending renewal or suspended status.

## Warranty work

While the contractor's warranty on the installed work stands, a fault on that equipment is warranty work. It is not charged to the maintenance agreement or to the owner's Demand Service Rate Programs, and the desk routes such a call to the project rather than dispatching it as billable service.

## Energy baseline

Where the building holds one of the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions whose class resets the baseline on retrofit, the closeout date is the baseline reset date.

## Rebates and extended warranty

A rebate application is filed by the company only where the class includes it, and the class's processing fee is charged on the rebate the owner actually receives, never on the estimate. Whether an extended equipment warranty plan may be attached at closeout is a setting of the class.

## Timeline (hypothetical)

| Day | Event | Effect on the other holdings |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | old rooftop unit removed | it leaves the maintenance schedule from the 3rd |
| 20th | substantial completion | the new unit joins the maintenance schedule from the 20th; the contractor's labor warranty begins |
| 24th | a fault on the new unit is reported | warranty work on the project; not billable service |
| 45th | project closed | where the energy subscription's class resets on retrofit, the 45th is the baseline reset date |

## Points of judgement

**A rebate of USD 12000 was estimated and USD 9000 was received, in a class that files the application.** The processing fee is charged on USD 9000, the rebate actually received.
